name: skillparity
description: CLI for multi-harness skill behavioral parity — SKILL.md as unit under test

scripts.test: node --test && node bin/skillparity.js run --skill examples/summarize-pr --parity examples/summarize-pr/parity.yaml --harness mock --ci
scripts.test:claude: node bin/skillparity.js run --skill examples/summarize-pr --parity examples/summarize-pr/parity.yaml --harness claude --ci --skip-ok
scripts.test:cursor: node bin/skillparity.js run --skill examples/summarize-pr --parity examples/summarize-pr/parity.yaml --harness cursor --ci --skip-ok
